scope: Analytical identifiability and model-limit witnesses. No newM3 arm, production changes, real capture claim or universal superiority claim.
comparison_rule: For each world class, construct indistinguishable observations and compare physically different targets. Distinguishable-input and model-limit controls are explicitly labeled and are not called information-theoretic impossibility.
failure_policy: Execute all16 controls once in listed order. Retain every FAIL/ERROR with assertions or traceback. Any source repair requires new protocol/version and retention of prior outputs. No results-dependent threshold changes.
acceptance: All predeclared Boolean checks in frozen source must pass. A passed negative witness confirms only the constructed case and its stated assumptions. It does not estimate population frequency, product inferiority, learned decoder performance or clinical acceptability.
numerical_policy: float64 analytic geometry. Exactuint8 RGB equality where claimed. Fixed tolerances1e-28 cell boundary,1e-12 lattice arithmetic,1e-10 calibrated positive. No stochastic sampling.
